reason: Production callers replace these errors with cataloged guidance; translating them would not change visible copy.
Thrown transport/validation errors become typed failure categories or are caught by InventoryConversation; raw exception messages are not rendered.
In-memory test API data and diagnostics are not production product copy.
Benchmark corpus and case labels are not production product copy.
WorkspaceCreationForm guards empty input and replaces command errors with cataloged access/connection guidance.
Scope-change exceptions become cataloged filtersCouldNotBeLoaded feedback; raw query errors are not rendered.
These values identify mutation outcomes and are mapped to customization catalog messages before rendering.
VoiceConversationExchange replaces query errors with its cataloged assetUnavailable message; raw exceptions are not rendered.

OnboardingScreen delegates typed partial-success failures and other errors to onboardingError; the presentation catalog supplies both recovery context and guidance. Application messages are not rendered directly.
English literals match application errors to catalog keys; they are not returned as display text.
The remaining English literal rejects invalid command identifiers. Supported checkout, return, details and undo availability errors use catalog messages.
Cancellation control flow is suppressed by query/task lifecycle handling; discovery and selection failures now use catalog guidance.
Runtime configuration exceptions feed auth failure categories or callback recovery; startup and callback surfaces render cataloged guidance rather than raw configuration errors.
Sign-in exceptions are handled by the sign-in and callback presentation paths. The OIDC scope string is protocol data, not UI copy.
Local incomplete-pagination errors are ordinary Error values, not safeForUser messages. NotificationInbox replaces them with cataloged load recovery through safeWorkspaceErrorMessage.
Local batch validation errors are ordinary Error values. NotificationInbox supplies cataloged mark-all recovery; these diagnostics do not define rendered notification labels.
